title: Spec 122 §8.2 step template freeze — declared artifact
description: WF2 'Step Template Freeze' (2026-09-04). Converts §8.2's prose promise ('freeze the template after the eighth, never the first') into a mechanically-checked artifact: a schema-shape hash ratchet (schema_sha256, checked both directions by src/tests/template-freeze.infra.test.ts's R-E lock), the measured category/archetype/runner surface at the moment of freezing, the LG-21 fork-over-share ratification, and the batching_prereq set open at freeze time. Generated by scripts/steps/_schema/generate-template-freeze.mjs from the live tree (categories/schema_sha256/phase_runners/archetype_profiles/batching_prereq_snapshot) plus a small set of declared, human-ruled constants (frozen_after_pilot, lg21_decision, does_not_freeze) that cannot be mechanically derived because they ARE the ruling — mirrors scripts/steps/_schema/schema-baseline.json's generated-with-a-reviewed-ratchet posture.

frozen_at.description: Full git SHA this artifact was regenerated at (--refresh advances it to HEAD; a plain regenerate leaves it as the last --refresh's commit, mirroring step-churn-complexity.mjs's window_end protocol). Must be an ancestor of HEAD.

frozen_after_pilot.description: The operator ruling (Spec 122 §8.2's own escape clause: 'if any of the eight forces a contract change, the count is not the eight, it is however many it takes'). A DECLARED constant, not derived — this IS the ruling this artifact exists to record.

schema_sha256.description: sha256 of scripts/steps/_schema/step.schema.json's current bytes. The R-E lock (template-freeze.infra.test.ts) requires this to equal a fresh hash of the live schema UNLESS the same commit also touches this file (a deliberate re-freeze) AND carries a non-empty Spec 122 §8 diff.

categories.description: step.schema.json's top-level `required` array, verbatim — the frozen category list (measured 20, not the stale '18' some older prose claims; see review_followups.md).

archetype_profiles.description: One row per identity.archetype enum value (8). `shapes`/`runners` are arrays because LINK maps to TWO execution.shape values in the live schema (link, link_keyed — link_massing/pilot3 and link_parcels/pilot7 respectively), a real branch Spec 124 §9's own phase-runner table does not currently show (filed review_followups.md, MED).

phase_runners.description: One row per built phase runner (7 — `assert` has none, ASSERT writes nothing). `phase_order` is the ordered, deduplicated (first-occurrence) sequence of staleness.*/write.*/acquire.*/pipeline.*/preWriteGate library calls the runner's source makes, mechanically extracted (never hand-transcribed prose) — GAP G-3 (Spec 124 Rule 11): a real code reorder changes this sequence and is caught by src/tests/template-freeze.infra.test.ts's re-derivation assertion; a comment-only edit cannot.

lg21_decision.description: The LG-21 (runPhaseScaffold shared-runner-scaffold) ratification: fork-over-share, RATIFIED at the freeze rather than consolidated — consolidating the 7 runners in the same commit that promises they stop changing would invert '§10b.1: enforcement must be harder to change than the enforced'. A declared ruling, not derived.

batching_prereq_snapshot.description: programme-items.json's open (status NOT BUILT/SUPERSEDED) batching_prereq set at the moment this file was generated — derived, re-generate after any programme-items.json change that touches this set (e.g. C6 closing STD-8/PRG-10 and opening FREEZE-1).

does_not_freeze.description: Explicit negative scope — what this freeze does NOT lock, so a reader never has to infer a boundary from silence (Spec 122 §8.2 plan, 'What the freeze does NOT freeze').
